dc_title_s: Aging and Disability Resource Center Regions, Wisconsin 2026
dc_description_s: This data represents aging and disability resource center region boundaries for Wisconsin in 2026. [This dataset contains boundaries for the Aging & Disability Resource Center regions. Local aging and disability resource centers (ADRCs) provide accurate, unbiased information on all aspects of life related to aging or living with a disability. For more information please visit the Wisconsin Department of Health Services website.
uw_supplemental_s: This is an archived copy of the data held at UW-Madison.
